manual_source_examples.finding: The model omits distinct FoX/NWChem/Avogadro modifications and dictionary entries, often retaining only generic artifact names. The source states each development explicitly. Short method names Avogadro/CML/NWChem are also scored as unmatched against expanded descriptions, so the measured error mixes missing information with alias/granularity sensitivity.

The source title explicitly names the FRENK Datasets; the model outputs FRENK Datasets while the reference uses FRENK. This appears to identify the same resource yet scores as an unmatched pair. Contributions also differ between the named dataset and generic dataset description; source review is needed before treating every FP/FN as a factual model error.

The sequence to sequence models are described as a background limitation, but the model includes them under method. It omits Wikipedia/Wizard of Wikipedia under dataset. It splits the retrieval/reading/conditioning method differently from the reference, causing additional FP/FN. Its long contribution claim about knowledgeable discussions is source-supported but absent from the reference, a candidate reference omission.
The SMT method selects A3, a sentence about out-of-vocabulary words in NMTs. Validation correctly flags that SMT is not in its selected evidence sentence.

interpretation: Positive paired improvement on this held-out cohort. All five facets improve, but gains differ by annotation source. Source review examples indicate both model errors and reference/matching granularity issues; these examples do not estimate their population proportions.
limitations: One training seed and 100 test papers
Existing-reference papers have prior project history; train/dev/test and pilot50 IDs are disjoint
AI reference labels have not been independently human validated
Post-evaluation manual examples are exploratory diagnosis; reported labels, threshold and official scores are unchanged
